meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through relentless questioning while generating docs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过持续提问帮你完善计划或设计，并同时生成架构决策记录和术语表。
howto.when: 当你输入 /grilling 命令时触发，该技能会调用 /domain-modeling 技能。

say.text: 我们来 /grilling 一下这个新功能的设计。

say.text: 用 /grilling 帮我打磨这个架构方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will run a relentless interview to sharpen your plan or design, and create ADRs and a glossary as you go.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type the /grilling command; it invokes the /domain-modeling skill.

say_en.text: Use /grilling to polish this architecture plan.
